purpose: Teach: いち早く/連ね/硬直/専任/クーポン/仕上がっ/大々的/各位

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 創業期、私、業界の変化、いち早く、察知してきたぞ、お前にも、見習って欲しい、本当に、頼むぞ、絶対に、これだけは。
lines.en: When we were starting out, I could sense shifts in the industry ahead of anyone else. I want you to learn that same instinct.
lines.style: Quiet authority. Opens with measured certainty. Slow, deliberate cadence — each phrase lands with weight. Ends with a gentle firmness, like passing down something precious and non-negotiable.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。創業時、社員数名、お父さんと共に、名を、連ねていたって、お母さんから、聞いております、本当に、すごい歴史、誇りです。
lines.en: Yes. Your mother told me how you worked alongside your father from the very beginning, just a handful of staff. It's an incredible history — I'm truly honored to be part of it.
lines.style: Respectful, almost reverent tone. Lean slightly inward. Warm acknowledgment mixed with genuine humility. The cadence of someone honoring a legacy they've inherited, not made.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 創業精神、硬直化、絶対、させるな、お前の代でも、若手の声、しっかり、聞け、本当に、頼むぞ、これは、絶対に、絶対だ。
lines.en: But don't let the founding spirit calcify under your watch. Even in your time, listen carefully to what the younger people are saying. This matters — this I'm asking you most seriously.
lines.style: Shift to firmer urgency. The opening is a warning delivered with care. Slightly raised intensity mid-phrase. Ends with weight — three words that carry the full gravity of what he's asking.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。専任の補佐、社長業務、お父さんの代から、続けて、頼っております、本当に、ありがたいですね、伝統、続けます、絶対に。
lines.en: Yes. The dedicated assistant who's handled company operations since your father's time — I'm grateful we can rely on that continuity. We'll carry that tradition forward, absolutely.
lines.style: Composed, respectful rhythm. Acknowledge the weight of inheritance without strain. Warm but measured. The final phrase is not boast but pledge — spoken with quiet confidence and sincerity.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お得意様クーポン、私の代から、続いている伝統、絶対、続けていけよ、お父さんから、頼むぞ、本当に、頼んだ、これだけは。
lines.en: The VIP customer discount program — it's been a tradition since my time. Keep it alive. Your father is asking you this. This is what matters most.
lines.style: Return to directorial tone. Deliberate pacing. Each clause sits distinctly. The repeated emphasis ('keep it alive,' 'is what matters') carries affection wrapped in urgency — not harsh, but unmistakably serious.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。創業五十周年記念誌、ようやく、仕上がってまいりました、お父さんに、お見せしたいです、本当に、見て、いただきたい、感想を。
lines.en: Yes. We've finally finished the fiftieth anniversary commemorative book. I'd very much like to show it to you, Father — to hear what you think of it.
lines.style: Soften noticeably. A note of quiet pride mixed with eagerness to share. Respectful but warmer. Build gently toward the request — it's genuine, not perfunctory.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 創業祭、大々的に、開催すること、お父さんとして、嬉しいぞ、お前、本当に、頑張ってくれて、感謝しているよ、本当に。
lines.en: A grand founding festival — I'm glad you're doing this. You've worked so hard for this company. I want you to know how grateful I am.
lines.style: Warmth breaks through. The opening is pleased and generous. Slow down on 'grateful' — let it breathe. There's emotion held in check but present. This is approval mixed with deep affection.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。創業者の親族各位、ご招待状、私から、心を込めて、お送りいたします、本当に、お父さんの代から、頼んでいきますね、絶対に、必ず。
lines.en: Yes. I'll personally send invitations to all the family members of the founders with my whole heart. I'm asking you to help me carry this forward from where your father began. Absolutely, without fail.
lines.style: Close with formal grace. Respectful and ceremonial but not stiff. Steady, deliberate pacing. The final phrases are a solemn promise wrapped in warmth — the voice of someone passing a baton with full confidence.
